# apipbx_speed_dial (Resource)

A speed dial: extensions dial *0 and the code to call the number. Import with "<tenant id>/<id>".



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code` (String) 1-4 digits.
- `number` (String) 2-20 characters from 0-9 * #: internal, or external through the outbound routes.
- `tenant_id` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `extension_id` (String) Make it this extension's own speed dial, which wins over the tenant's of the same code. Without it the speed dial is the tenant's.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
